Sub-leases and Options
In a sub-lease agreement dated July 15, 1972, Westmoreland Resources sub-leased all of Tract II to Northern States Power Company subject to approval by the Secretary of the Interior. Northern States Power Company in turn has sub-leased Tract II to Cormorant Corporation, its wholly owned mining subsidiary. The sub-lease has been approved by the Crow Tribe.
In discussing development of the coal reserves of Tract II it must be recognized that if the sub-lease is approved by the Secretary of the Interior, Northern States Power may contract with a firm other than Westmoreland Resources in mining the coal reserves.
In April 1976, Westmoreland Resources purchased back an option previously granted to Colorado Interstate Gas Company. This option would have allowed CIG to acquire up to 300 million tons of coal from Tract III as a future supply for coal gasification. The option differed from the previously discussed Northern States Power Company sub-lease in that CIG could have purchased coal from the lease for use in a coal conversion plant on or near the leased lands without approval of the Crow Tribe, since the CIG agreement had been made prior to renegotiation of the leases.
